description: This file declares functions, structures, and external variables related to tracking and displaying progress information within a version control system, likely Git. It includes function prototypes for starting, stopping, and displaying progress, as well as conditional testing variables and functions.

methods.name: display_throughput
methods.description: Displays the throughput information for a progress operation.

methods.name: start_progress
methods.description: Initializes and starts a standard progress tracking for a given repository.

methods.name: start_sparse_progress
methods.description: Starts progress tracking in sparse mode for a repository.

methods.name: start_delayed_progress
methods.description: Starts progress tracking in delayed mode for a repository.

methods.name: start_delayed_sparse_progress
methods.description: Starts sparse, delayed progress tracking for a repository.

methods.name: stop_progress_msg
methods.description: Stops the progress tracking, displaying a provided message.

methods.name: void stop_progress(struct progress ** p_progress)
methods.description: Stops progress tracking with a default message 'done'.
